usage: fsq_campaign.py [-h]
                       {prepare-clock,qualify,rehearse,calibrate,run,_episode}
                       ...

FSQ-only future qualification and single-attempt campaign gates. No Android,
FSQ, AMKernel or Appium module is imported by the offline consumers. Live
subcommands require independently reviewed, target-exclusive authorization.
Qualification consumes existing apps/snapshots: it never installs, repairs,
saves a replacement snapshot, or invents a first-launch UI recipe. Rehearsal
is a separate non-scoring official lifecycle check, not evidence that the FSQ
policy succeeds.

positional arguments:
  {prepare-clock,qualify,rehearse,calibrate,run,_episode}
    prepare-clock
    qualify
    rehearse
    calibrate
    run
    _episode            ==SUPPRESS==

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
